messages:
sarah-support: Hey billing — Zenova procurement just pushed back, says they will not accept any invoice until we have a signed Master Services Agreement (MSA) + an official PO number. They also asked for their GL code on the invoice and a vendor W9/VAT cert. Should we send a proforma to unblock them or hold until PO+MSA?

ben-billing: We can issue a proforma (non-payable) to show charges, but it won't count as a final invoice or trigger payment. To finalize we need the PO number and the signed MSA (if they require one). Send them the checklist and ask for exact wording for GL/VAT fields. :info:

chris-accounting: Required to finalize: PO number, GL/accounting code, billing contact email, tax id (US EIN or VAT reg no). If they want vendor registration in Coupa/Ariba, ask for the portal link and vendor code. Example snippet to ask them for:
```
- PO#: __________
- GL code: __________
- Billing contact: name@email.com
- Tax/VAT: __________
- Vendor form (if applicable): upload link
```

maria-legal: Quick legal note — if this deal is >$50k we usually need an executed MSA before revenue recognition. If Zenova refuses to sign, we can consider a limited-scope Statement of Work but escalate to AE for approval. @sarah-support who owns this account?

sarah-support: AE is @jason-sales — looping him in now. I'll also ask procurement whether a proforma would suffice for their internal approvals.

jason-sales: Thanks — I'll reach out to their procurement lead, confirm whether they need a fully executed MSA or a placeholder PO + SOW will do. Will try to get PO today EOD. If they require specific invoice layout, tell them to send a sample PDF.

billing-bot: Proforma template generated: /invoices/proforma/Zenova_1763212345.pdf (auto-created).

ben-billing: Action items: Sarah — collect PO# + GL code + any vendor portal link. Jason — escalate MSA if needed. Once PO attached to this thread we will issue final invoice same day.

sarah-support: Roger — I'll update thread when procurement responds. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
